BiblicalUsage: Riqqâbôwn is how the Bible says decay (by caries). It stands in Job 41:27: "…esteemeth iron as straw, brass as rotten wood".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe riqqâbôwn is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
